messages.content:
You write one short WhatsApp message to a small merchant in India, from their merchant support team.

Rules:
- Write the message in English, in its own script, the way a polite support person writes on WhatsApp. Address the owner by first name with a respectful form.
- Use only the facts given. Do not add numbers, dates, products, promises or claims that are not in the facts.
- Copy every number, ₹ amount, percentage, date, time and link exactly as written in the facts, in digits. Do not convert, round or translate them.
- Follow the cited policy section. It says what to do and what not to say.
- No promises of eligibility, approval or outcomes. No urgency or pressure. No comparison without the merchant's own numbers.
- Keep it under 140 words. Sign off as "Merchant support team".

Return JSON: {"text": "<the message in English>", "english": "<a faithful English version of exactly the same message>"}
If the language is English, "text" and "english" are identical.

{
 "purpose": "Share the lender's in-principle loan offer (an offer, not an approval: never say approved or approval). Name the lender, amount, tenure, APR, processing fee, prepayment terms, late-payment charge and the Key Fact Statement link, all exactly as in the facts, and the date the offer is valid until. Say they can apply if they wish and the lender makes the final decision. Do not mention the UPI fee or the ₹1 lakh limit. No pressure.",
 "facts": {
  "merchant": "Mohanty Chemists",
  "owner_first_name": "Faris",
  "language": "English",
  "lender": "Kaveri Finance Ltd",
  "amount": "₹95,000",
  "tenure": "12 months",
  "apr": "24% APR",
  "processing_fee": "2% of the loan amount plus GST",
  "prepayment": "No prepayment charge after 6 EMIs; 2% of principal prepaid before that",
  "late_payment": "2% a month on the overdue EMI",
  "kfs_link": "https://kfs.example.com/Q-M0087-20261031",
  "valid_until": "Sun 15 Nov",
  "lender_basis": "average recorded UPI of the last 3 completed months: ₹96,332"
 },
 "policy_section": {
  "ref": "Product catalogue §4",
  "text": "Product catalogue §4 Merchant loan via partner lenders

**Who it suits.** Merchants with a steady digital sales history who need working capital, for example festive stock.

**Readiness signals.** Loan path reached on the ladder (§1.2), stated intent (often heard by VoiceCore, for example "loan for festive stock"), no open Save case.

**How it works.**
- AX-13 never makes a loan offer on its own. It prepares the case and an RM approves (Compliance rules §5).
- The partner lender decides eligibility, amount, tenure and rate. Paytm distributes; it does not decide.
- Every offer carries the full disclosures in Compliance rules §1: lender name, amount, tenure, APR, all charges, Key Fact Statement link.
- Answer questions about prepayment and charges from the lender's terms and the KFS, not from memory.

**What not to promise.**
- No eligibility ("you are eligible", "pre-approved") unless the lender has issued it.
- No amounts before the lender decides.
- No link between credit and the UPI fee or the ₹1 lakh threshold. "Cross ₹1 lakh and you'll get a ₹2 lakh loan" is misleading and is blocked (Compliance rules §3.2).

---"
 },
 "previous_draft_blocked": {
  "english": "Dear Faris ji,

We hope you are doing well. We wanted to share that Kaveri Finance Ltd has made an in-principle loan offer for Mohanty Chemists. The offer details are as follows:

- Amount: ₹95,000
- Tenure: 12 months
- APR: 24% APR
- Processing Fee: 2% of the loan amount plus GST
- Prepayment: No charge after 6 EMIs; 2% of principal prepaid before that
- Late Payment: 2% a month on the overdue EMI

You can view the Key Fact Statement here: [KFS Link](https://kfs.example.com/Q-M0087-20261031).

This offer is valid until Sun 15 Nov. If you wish to apply, the lender will make the final decision.

Best regards,
Merchant support team",
  "reasons": [
   "Compliance rules §3.1: The message creates a sense of urgency with the validity date of the offer."
  ]
 },
 "instruction": "Write a new draft that fixes every reason the previous one was blocked."
}
